title: Add a Last Modified column to the guide index (write side)
description: Companion, write-side plan to ai-intake-mcp's read-side plan for the same feature: sync_guide stamps a Last Modified date on every guide's index row (append after Tags), and migrates an already-published 4-column index table in place. Must stay in sync with the ai-intake-mcp plan on exact column name, date format, and position — that plan is the read side of this same table shape.
